answer.reason: The coastal city of Caesarea is the setting for the story of Cornelius and for Paul's custody before the governor.

clauses.english: was where the centurion Cornelius lived and received Peter
clauses.quote: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius

clauses.english: was where Paul was brought before the governor and kept in custody
clauses.quote: when they came to Caesarea and delivered the epistle to the governor

doubts: MAT 16:13 and MRK 8:27 name Caesarea Philippi, a different place, so they were left out.
The other verses only mention travel to or through Caesarea, so they were not used.
